body: did you know: the tortured poets department was a secret double album -- and no one knew until 2am. two hours after the midnight drop, taylor revealed 15 more songs. 31 total. "i'd written so much tortured poetry in the past 2 years and wanted to share it all with you."
why: X-native (text-only) version of the TTPD secret-double-album did-you-know, keeping X active and filling the coldest era corner (TTPD has zero prior social coverage). Trimmed to the punchiest facts: the 2 a.m. reveal two hours after the midnight drop, The Anthology's 15 extra tracks for 31 total, and Taylor's own 'i'd written so much tortured poetry...' line. Every claim traces to the Vault TTPD 'secret double album' item (Billboard/Rolling Stone/Deseret). Rollout craft lore only, outside every blocklist topic.
